name: extension
description: Use this Shopify theme detector to see any store's theme, apps and trackers: an app detector and pixel checker with CSV export.
_overrides_note: web-ext is wxt 0.21's optional peer for launching a dev browser (npm run dev / dev:firefox). It pins adm-zip and shell-quote to ranges that exclude the patched releases, so npm audit fix is a no-op and these overrides force the fixed versions instead. Neither is bundled into the extension -- they run only in the local dev launcher. Extension CI gates on an unscoped `npm audit`, so these are load-bearing: removing one turns CI red rather than merely raising the noise. Drop each once web-ext ships a bump that covers it, which `npm audit` passing without it will confirm.
